column3: NKJV renders “loved by a companion” as “loved by a lover” and adds “of the pagans” to “raisin cakes.”
NKJV renders “a homer of barley and a lethech of barley” as “one and one-half homers of barley,” and supplies “shekels.”
Close to the Hebrew; “and also I to you” is rendered “so, too, will I be toward you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will come trembling to Yahweh” is rendered “They shall fear the LORD.”
